# Vijetha Digital

> Vijetha Digital is a commercial printing and signage company based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Established in 2009, the company provides LED sign boards, ACP cladding signs, vehicle branding, flex printing, offset printing, exhibition displays, and complete branding solutions to 1,000+ businesses across South India.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2009
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India (3 branches: Nacharam, Lakdikapool, Indira Park)
- Specialisation: Commercial printing, signage fabrication, vehicle branding, exhibition displays
- Production: 10,000 sq.ft in-house facility at Nacharam IDA
- Equipment: HP Latex 570, Epson Surecolor S80670, Roland Soljet EJ 640, K Tech CNC router
- Capacity: 1 lakh sq.ft per day (flex/vinyl printing)
- Contact: +91 92481 95552 | info@vijethadigital.com
- Website: https://vijethadigital.com

## Services & Products

- [LED Sign Boards](https://vijethadigital.com/products/led-sign-board) — Illuminated boards from Rs 3,500. IP65 weatherproof, 2-year warranty.
- [ACP Cladding Signs](https://vijethadigital.com/products/acp-cladding-sign) — Aluminium composite panel signs from Rs 2,200.
- [Acrylic Letter Signs](https://vijethadigital.com/products/acrylic-letter-sign) — CNC-cut 3D acrylic letters from Rs 1,800.
- [Vehicle Branding](https://vijethadigital.com/products/car-4-wheeler-wrap) — Car, van, bus, truck wraps using 3M/Avery Dennison vinyl.
- [Flex & Vinyl Printing](https://vijethadigital.com/products/flex-vinyl-printing) — Large format from Rs 18/sq.ft, same-day under 500 sq.ft.
- [Offset Printing](https://vijethadigital.com/products/brochure-catalogue) — Brochures, catalogues, stationery.
- [Exhibition Displays](https://vijethadigital.com/products/trade-show-booth) — Trade show booths, roll-up standees, fabric light boxes.
- [Pylon Signs](https://vijethadigital.com/products/pylon-sign) — Freestanding pylons from 8–40 feet.
- [Office & Retail Branding](https://vijethadigital.com/products/office-wall-branding) — Internal branding, reception walls, wayfinding.

## Turnaround Times

- Flex/vinyl banners: Same day (under 500 sq.ft, order before 12 PM)
- LED sign boards: 5–7 working days
- ACP cladding: 7–10 working days
- Vehicle wraps: 1–2 days
- Offset printing: 3–5 working days
- Exhibition booths: 10–15 working days
